title: FluidR3 GM — Woodblock (MIDI program 116), note 56
processing: MP3 note sample decoded to mono, resampled to 22.05 kHz, first 0.36 s kept, 0.6 ms fade-in and 30 ms fade-out, peak normalised, stored as 16-bit PCM in base64. Mogeo (wooden fish): the recording resampled to 0.46x speed plus a resonator tuned to its lowest mode. Moktak (since 2026-11-24): only the first 30 ms of the recording (resampled to 0.6x) is used as the strike; it drives a bank of resonators whose frequencies, levels and decay times were measured from a real temple moktak recording (see moktakReference).
note: Built from a recording of a real wooden percussion instrument and tuned to a real temple moktak; not a recording of the moktak at Bulguksa.

moktakReference.use: Listened to on the public preview on 2026-11-24 and measured only: three isolated strikes gave main partials near 380 Hz (0 dB), 325 Hz (about -7 dB), 1022 Hz (about -16 dB), almost no energy above 2.5 kHz, and a level drop of about 10 dB at 0.3 s and 30 dB at 0.9 s. The audio itself was not downloaded into the repository or copied into the sound.
